{"hypotheses": [
  {"name": "Hypothesis01",
   "mechanism": "Bullish market regimes favor high-momentum stocks overvalue while bearish market regimes reward low-beta stocks' stability, creating a return premium.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Beta"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis02",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth and high earnings forecast revisions are likely to be undervalued, creating a return premium in bullish market regimes.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "AnalystRevision"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis03",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high operating profitability and low book-to-market ratios are likely to outperform in bearish market regimes.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.5,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis04",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high R&D expenditures and low market leverage are undervalued in developed non-US markets.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.5,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis05",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high R&D ability and low book leverage are likely to be undervalued, creating a return premium in bullish market regimes.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RDAbility"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis06",
   "mechanism": "Low momentum and low volatility firms are likely to be undervalued, creating a return premium in bearish market regimes.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "RealizedVol"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis07",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high governance scores and high predicted earnings forecasts are likely to be undervalued.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Governance"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "PredictedFE"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60
  },
  {"name": "Hypothesis08",
   "mechanism": "Firms with high cash-to-asset ratios and low beta are likely to be undervalued, creating a return premium in bearish market regimes.",
   "expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Cash"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Beta"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "vol_target": true},
   "auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}],
   "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6,
   "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36
  }
]}
